tv_academy_debate_change_local_progress_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_progress_owner
	custom_description = {
		text = tv_academy_debate_change_local_progress_text
		value = $value$
		every_international_organizations_member_of = {
			limit = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
				leader_country ?= scope:tv_academy_debate_progress_owner
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position add = $value$ }
			clamp_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_set_local_progress_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_progress_owner
	every_international_organizations_member_of = {
		limit = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
			leader_country ?= scope:tv_academy_debate_progress_owner
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_progress_delta value = $value$ }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_progress_delta subtract = var:tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position }
		leader_country ?= {
			tv_academy_debate_change_local_progress_effect = { value = local_var:tv_academy_debate_local_progress_delta }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_remove_group_seated_by_id_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_nobility_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 2 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_clergy_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 3 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_burghers_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 4 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_peasants_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 5 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_tribes_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 6 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_dhimmi_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 7 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_cossacks_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 8 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_scholarly_community_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 9 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_public_opinion_seated
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $group$ ?= 10 }

tv_academy_debate_refresh_local_balance_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_balance_owner
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_support_count value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_stance ?= 1 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_support_count add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_stance ?= 2 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_stance ?= 1 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_support_count add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_stance ?= 2 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_stance ?= 1 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_support_count add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_stance ?= 2 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_stance ?= 1 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_support_count add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_stance ?= 2 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_stance ?= 1 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_support_count add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_stance ?= 2 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_count add = 1 }
	}
	every_international_organizations_member_of = {
		limit = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
			leader_country ?= scope:tv_academy_debate_balance_owner
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_support_seats value = local_var:tv_academy_debate_local_support_count }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_seats value = local_var:tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_count }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_decisive_seats value = var:tv_academy_debate_local_support_seats }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_decisive_seats add = var:tv_academy_debate_local_oppose_seats }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_balance value = 50 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_local_decisive_seats > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_balance value = var:tv_academy_debate_local_support_seats }
			change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_balance divide = var:tv_academy_debate_local_decisive_seats }
			change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_balance multiply = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_local_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_local_decisive_seats
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group }
		tv_academy_debate_remove_group_seated_by_id_effect = { group = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group }
	}
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_stance
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_cooldown
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_artist
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_foreign_country
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_scientist
}

tv_academy_philosophy_accept_meritocracy_effect = {
	every_owned_location = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:meritocracy value = 100 } }
	research_advance = advance_type:meritocracy_advance
}

	}
	else_if = {

		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_renaissance_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 3 }
		tv_academy_philosophy_accept_banking_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 4 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 5 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue ?= 6 }

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {

	}
}

				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_global_trade_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_manufactories_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_scientific_revolution_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { opinion = { target = root value >= 1 } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { opinion = { target = root value < 0 } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_price_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 1 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 2 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 3 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 4 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 5 } }
	}
}

			trigger = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 18 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }

				NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_royal_option_1_group ?= 47 }
				NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_royal_option_2_group ?= 47 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_royal_option_3_group value = 47 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_group_warrior_clans_available_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_group_warrior_clans_supports_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_royal_option_1_group ?= 48 }
				NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_royal_option_2_group ?= 48 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_royal_option_3_group value = 48 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_group_diplomatic_clans_available_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_group_diplomatic_clans_supports_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_royal_option_1_group ?= 49 }
				NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_royal_option_2_group ?= 49 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_royal_option_3_group value = 49 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_royal_option_1_group }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.109 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_prepare_quarrel_event_effect = {
	tv_academy_debate_clear_event_state_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_pick_unseated_support_group_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group
		tv_academy_debate_pick_unseated_oppose_group_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat_2 value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat_2 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_seat_2
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance_2 value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.104 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_prepare_selected_special_scope_effect = {
	clear_saved_scope = tv_academy_debate_selected_artist
	clear_saved_scope = tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country
	clear_saved_scope = tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 16 }
		random_character = {
			limit = { is_alive = yes is_artist = yes }
			save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_selected_artist
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 17 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_allied_with = { target = root }
					is_neighbor_of = root
					is_rival_of = root
					is_at_war_with = root
				}
			}
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 18 }
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_count_seated_sides_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_left_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_right_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_left_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_left_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_right_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_right_count add = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_right_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group }
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 3 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 2 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_left_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group }
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 2 }

				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 3 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_any_empty_seat_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 2 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 3 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 4 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 5 }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_seat_for_selected_stance_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_stance ?= 1 }
		tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_right_seat_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_stance ?= 2 }
		tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_left_seat_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		tv_academy_debate_count_seated_sides_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_left_count < var:tv_academy_debate_right_count }
			tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_left_seat_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_right_count < var:tv_academy_debate_left_count }
			tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_right_seat_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			tv_academy_debate_pick_any_empty_seat_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 17 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country } }
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_selected_special_scope_effect = yes
		}
		tv_academy_debate_set_selected_foreign_stance_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_seat } }
		tv_academy_debate_pick_seat_for_selected_stance_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
		tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_specific_seat_effect = { seat = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 2 NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group } }
		tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_specific_seat_effect = { seat = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 3 NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group } }
		tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_specific_seat_effect = { seat = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 4 NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group } }
		tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_specific_seat_effect = { seat = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 5 NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group } }
		tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_specific_seat_effect = { seat = 5 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_specific_seat_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group }
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_stance value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_stance }
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_cooldown value = 60 }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_artist } set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_artist value = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_artist } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country } set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_foreign_country value = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist } set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_scientist value = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist } }
	tv_academy_debate_mark_selected_group_seated_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_refresh_local_balance_effect = yes
}

tv_academy_debate_set_selected_neutral_stance_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = $stance$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_stance value = $stance$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown value = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_stance value = $stance$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_cooldown value = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 3 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_stance value = $stance$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_cooldown value = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 4 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_stance value = $stance$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_cooldown value = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 5 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_stance value = $stance$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_cooldown value = 60 }
	}
	tv_academy_debate_refresh_local_balance_effect = yes
}

tv_academy_debate_set_selected_neutral_to_support_effect = {
	tv_academy_debate_set_selected_neutral_stance_effect = { stance = 1 }
}

tv_academy_debate_set_selected_neutral_to_oppose_effect = {
	tv_academy_debate_set_selected_neutral_stance_effect = { stance = 2 }
}

tv_academy_debate_apply_selected_price_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 1 }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 2 }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = -2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 3 }
		add_prestige = -10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 4 }
		add_legitimacy = -5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 5 }
		add_stability = -7
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_cleanup_invalid_special_seats_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_artist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_artist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_auto_seat_vacated_pending value = 1 }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_1_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_scientist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_scientist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_auto_seat_vacated_pending value = 1 }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_1_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_foreign_country NOT = { country_exists = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_foreign_country } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_auto_seat_vacated_pending value = 1 }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_1_effect = yes

tv_academy_debate_decrement_cooldowns_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_dispatch_monthly_seat_event_effect = {
	random_list = {
		5 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_join_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_seated_group_that_can_leave_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_leave_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_support_price_join_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_oppose_price_stay_out_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_has_two_empty_seats_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_quarrel_event_effect = yes
		}
		2 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes

			}

		2 = {

			}

		}
		1 = {

		1 = {

		1 = {

			}

		2 = {

tv_academy_debate_dispatch_monthly_progress_event_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
				var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
				tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.2000 days = 1 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
				var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
				tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.2001 days = 1 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
				var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
				tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.2002 days = 1 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1

				tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }

		}

			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.2004 days = 1 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
				var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
				tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.2005 days = 1 }
		}

				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }

tv_academy_debate_dispatch_auto_stance_notifications_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_stance_support_pending NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.122 days = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_stance_support_pending
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_stance_oppose_pending NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.123 days = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_stance_oppose_pending
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_stance_neutral_pending NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.124 days = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_stance_neutral_pending
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_seat_vacated_pending NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending } }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.125 days = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_auto_seat_vacated_pending
}

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_academy_debate_group_to_estate is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_academy_debate_group_to_estate target = local_var:tv_academy_debate_result_group } }
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_result_estate value = "global_variable_map(tv_academy_debate_group_to_estate|local_var:tv_academy_debate_result_group)" }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = local_var:tv_academy_debate_result_estate value = 0.10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group ?= 16 }
			var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_artist ?= { add_artist_skill = 0.20 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group ?= 17 }
			var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_foreign_country ?= { add_prestige = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group ?= 18 }
			var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_scientist ?= { add_adm = 10 add_dip = 10 }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_apply_seat_loser_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_result_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_academy_debate_group_to_estate is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_academy_debate_group_to_estate target = local_var:tv_academy_debate_result_group } }
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_result_estate value = "global_variable_map(tv_academy_debate_group_to_estate|local_var:tv_academy_debate_result_group)" }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = local_var:tv_academy_debate_result_estate value = -0.10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group ?= 16 }
			var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_artist ?= { kill_character = this }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group ?= 17 }
			var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_foreign_country ?= { add_prestige = -10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_group ?= 18 }
			var:tv_academy_debate_seat_$seat$_scientist ?= { add_adm = -10 add_dip = -10 }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_check_debate_endpoint_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
				leader_country ?= root
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position >= 100
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue value = var:tv_academy_philosophy_current }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_phase value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_research.43 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
				leader_country ?= root
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position <= 0
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue value = var:tv_academy_philosophy_current }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_phase value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_research.44 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_resolve_pending_acceptance_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind ?= 1
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue
		}
		tv_academy_debate_apply_acceptance_seat_results_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_apply_pending_acceptance_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_advance_current_issue_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_enter_recess_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_clear_debate_result_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_action_trigger_meritocracy_positive_on_cabinet_assigned_1_effect = {
	# Semantic condition: appoint_high_skill_non_hereditary_cabinet_member
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
				leader_country ?= root
			}
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1
			NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
		}
		random_list = {
			25 = {
				tv_academy_debate_change_local_progress_effect = { value = 5 }
				tv_academy_philosophy_check_debate_endpoint_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.116 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			75 = { }
		}
	}
}

	remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_issue
	remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_node
	remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_result
	remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_delta
	remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat
	remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_decisive_seats
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_progress value = 50 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_strength value = 50 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_months value = 0 }
	tv_academy_world_debate_clear_seats_effect = yes
}

		limit = { has_global_variable_list = tv_academy_world_debate_participants }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = tv_academy_world_debate_participants
			remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_participant
			remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_stance
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_world_debate_try_begin_for_country_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_academy_world_debate_country_has_academy_trigger = yes
			var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 2
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_active }
			}
		}
		situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
			tv_academy_world_debate_initialize_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_active value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_issue value = prev.var:tv_academy_philosophy_current }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_node value = prev.var:tv_academy_debate_current_node }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_progress value = 50 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_strength value = 50 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_months value = 0 }
			tv_academy_world_debate_refresh_seats_effect = yes
			tv_academy_world_debate_mirror_all_countries_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable_list = tv_academy_world_debate_participants }
				every_in_global_list = {
					variable = tv_academy_world_debate_participants
					limit = {
						tv_academy_world_debate_country_has_academy_trigger = yes
						var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= prev.var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue
					}
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.118 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_world_debate_monthly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_active }
		tv_academy_world_debate_refresh_seats_effect = yes
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_months add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_delta value = var:tv_academy_world_debate_strength }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_delta add = -50 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_delta divide = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_delta multiply = 5 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_progress add = var:tv_academy_world_debate_delta }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_progress min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_progress <= 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_result value = 2 }
			tv_academy_world_debate_resolve_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_progress >= 100 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_result value = 1 }
			tv_academy_world_debate_resolve_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_months >= 120 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_result value = 3 }
			tv_academy_world_debate_resolve_effect = yes
		}
		tv_academy_world_debate_mirror_all_countries_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_world_debate_refresh_seats_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_active } }
		tv_academy_world_debate_clear_seats_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_active }
		tv_academy_world_debate_clear_seats_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat value = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { tv_academy_world_debate_country_can_participate_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_participant value = 1 }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_participants target = this }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_stance value = 3 }
			if = {
				limit = { tv_academy_world_debate_country_supports_current_issue_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_stance value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { tv_academy_world_debate_country_opposes_current_issue_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_stance value = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance ?= 1 }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_support_seats add = 1 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance ?= 2 }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_oppose_seats add = 1 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance ?= 3 }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_neutral_seats add = 1 } }
			}
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_count add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat ?= 1 } }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_1_country value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_1_stance value = prev.var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance }
					change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat ?= 2 } }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_2_country value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_2_stance value = prev.var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance }
					change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat ?= 3 } }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_3_country value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_3_stance value = prev.var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance }
					change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat ?= 4 } }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_4_country value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_4_stance value = prev.var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance }
					change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat ?= 5 } }
				situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_5_country value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_seat_5_stance value = prev.var:tv_academy_world_debate_stance }
					change_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_next_seat ?= 6 } }

				}

tv_academy_world_debate_resolve_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_active has_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_result }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable_list = tv_academy_world_debate_participants }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = tv_academy_world_debate_participants
				limit = {
					tv_academy_world_debate_country_has_academy_trigger = yes
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= root.var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue
				}
				tv_academy_world_debate_apply_country_result_effect = yes
			}
		}
		remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_active
		remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_issue
		remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_node
		remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_result
		remove_variable = tv_academy_world_debate_delta
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_progress value = 50 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_strength value = 50 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_world_debate_months value = 0 }
		tv_academy_world_debate_clear_seats_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_world_debate_apply_country_result_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_meritocracy_progressive value = 1 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_meritocracy_conservative
			tv_academy_philosophy_accept_meritocracy_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 2 } NOT = { has_embraced_institution = institution:meritocracy } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_meritocracy_conservative value = 1 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_meritocracy_progressive
		}
		tv_academy_philosophy_advance_current_issue_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_enter_recess_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 1 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.119 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.120 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 3 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.121 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_renaissance_progressive value = 1 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_renaissance_conservative
			tv_academy_philosophy_accept_renaissance_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 2 } NOT = { has_embraced_institution = institution:renaissance } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_renaissance_conservative value = 1 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_renaissance_progressive
		}
		tv_academy_philosophy_advance_current_issue_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_enter_recess_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 1 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.119 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 2 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.120 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 3 } }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.121 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_result ?= 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_banking_progressive value = 1 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_banking_conservative
			tv_academy_philosophy_accept_banking_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {

		}
		else = {

		}
		if = {

tv_academy_philosophy_apply_monthly_debate_drift_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
		}
		trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.1 days = 1 }
	}
}
